text:
Dana Lewis: EdgeForge SOW back with a pretty bespoke ask: 70% "trial" discount for first 60 days IF they convert to Dedicated within 90 days, plus 60-day Net payment after invoice. Also asking for a 25% rev-share on Search-API overage above 200M tokens for 12 months. Can we approve?

Omar Khan: Who owns the account and what's the expected baseline usage?

Dana Lewis: Owner: Dana (AE). Pilot 60 days, est 30M tokens/mo, but conversion to Dedicated would push to ~500M tokens/mo. They want the big discount contingent on conversion to lock us as infra partner.

Priya Singh: This bundles pricing, billing terms, and a revenue-share — a lot of knobs. Finance policy: contingent discounts that hinge on conversion need a break clause and auditability. We rarely do rev-share on overages; that changes our revenue recognition and billing engine. Net60 on new logos requires PO + credit sign-off.

Marta Ruiz: Legal: any contingent conversion clause needs specific acceptance triggers (signed conversion SOW or auto-convert on usage) and data we can audit. Rev-share requires reporting cadence and audit rights. Also, rev-share introduces a variable consideration that needs to be accounted for under ASC606. Recommend simple one-time conversion credit instead of ongoing rev-share.

Dana Lewis: Sales counter suggestion to keep the customer moving: 50% trial discount (60 days) + $25k one-time conversion credit applied on first Dedicated invoice if they convert within 90 days. Keep billing Net30; customer prefers Net60 but may accept Net30 with PO. No rev-share.

Omar Khan: Finance reaction: 50% + $25k conversion credit is more palatable. Need to set a maximum effective concession and cap our contingent liability. Also require that conversion be triggered by signed conversion SOW and that credit flows as contra-revenue on Dedicated invoice. Collections wants PO for Net60 requests; otherwise Net30.

Priya Singh: Proposed deal desk summary for approval:
```
Item: Pilot (30M tokens/mo) - list $3,600/mo
Requested: 70% trial discount (60d) contingent on conversion + Net60 + 25% overage rev-share for 12mo
Finance/Legal counter: 50% trial discount (60d) + $25,000 one-time conversion credit applied to first Dedicated invoice if signed conversion SOW within 90d. Billing Net30 standard; Net60 allowed only with PO + credit instrument. No ongoing rev-share. Require VP-Finance & Head of Legal approval.
```

approvals-bot: Approval ticket APP-6788 created -> assigned to Omar Khan + VP-Finance + Head of Legal (Marta Ruiz cc). Link: https://internal/approvals/APP-6788 :white_check_mark:

Dana Lewis: Sales can accept finance/legal counter. I'll update SOW with the conversion credit language and note pending APP-6788. Holding execution until approval resolved.

Omar Khan: I'll run quick credit check and coordinate VP-Finance review. If approved, RevenueOps will implement contra-credit flow and Collections will tag the account for PO requirement if Net60 is chosen.

Priya Singh: Logging for deal desk. If VP-Finance signs off, Ops needs exact credit GL and rev rec instructions. Thanks.
